svg.text: A stone harbor: a long breakwater round a basin of quays, a terraced town climbing behind, cliffs and the light on the west headland, flats to the east.
Dense: quays, warehouses and terraced streets make short
sightlines, corners and rooftops. The breakwater is the one long
exposed walk, out to its beacon. The Lily waits past the gap.
Train into the depot at the town's east end
Port missions up and down the terraces
Win the marker: the Gilded Parlor, upper street
The launch from the gilded quay
crabs at low tide, eels in pools
a bounty in the empty pit
THE GILDED LILY · THE DECKS WE PLAY
true scale: 180 m long, 24 m across · bow to the right · the launch slips in with the coal lighters, low on the starboard side
UPPER DECKS · promenade, lifeboats, funnels, bridge
through the boilers to the vault
